context_compiler.finding: Deterministic bounded reference-only selection. ContextItem binds payload/source SHA-256, source generation, source classification, provenance/evidence refs; ContextView records selected and omitted items. Compiler explicitly does not read payload bytes or infer relevance/truth.

epistemic_adapter.finding: Exact record type fixes epistemic channel; payload/source/provenance/evidence digests remain explicit. Adapter does not decode payload semantics or mint truth/retrieval/effect authority.

existing_headroom_falsifier.finding: Source-derived fixture falsified unconditional recovery under marker-before-put failure, TTL expiry, and same-key overwrite. Upstream Rust runtime was not reproduced and no E3 runtime credit exists.

source_findings.finding: CCR ContextTracker requires a workspace_key for proactive expansion and fails closed to no recommendation when project identity is unresolved. This is a useful provenance-gating pattern.

CompressionStore stores original and compressed content behind a hash key with TTL and retrieval metadata. Default key is truncated SHA-256(original), with an explicit-hash escape hatch for producer compatibility.

CCR adds a distinct compression/retrieval store, optional persistent backend, TTL/eviction and retrieval-event state. Importing that store as authoritative F2 context state would create a competing retrieval/state surface.

SmartCrusher supports lossless structural compaction and an opt-in lossless_only mode; it also has lossy row-drop/opaque offload paths using CCR markers. audit_safe can force protected matching rows to survive and can fail closed on protected-row loss.

Headroom compression inspects payload content and uses content/relevance heuristics. F2 ContextCompiler intentionally does not read payload bytes or infer relevance, so Headroom must not be inserted inside the compiler's deterministic reference-selection authority.

hypothesis: A thin Headroom-derived structural compaction primitive could reduce rendered payload tokens while preserving F2's canonical evidence and deterministic context-selection boundaries.
counterhypothesis: WP306 already supplies the needed bounded context mechanism; any additional compression layer adds opacity, alternate storage/retrieval state and failure modes without enough incremental token benefit.
required_f2_boundaries_if_ablated: Canonical original payload remains in existing F2/UnifiedDB authority; no second canonical truth or retrieval DB.
Compaction is a derived noncanonical payload projection downstream of ContextCompiler selection, never a replacement for ContextItem identity or epistemic classification.
Derived compact artifact binds original payload_ref + full payload_sha256 + transformation version/config + compact-artifact digest + provenance refs.
No recoverable-omission marker may be emitted before durable original availability is acknowledged at the canonical F2 source.
Missing, expired, overwritten or digest-mismatched original fails closed; no guessed reconstruction.
Lossless structural mode is evaluated first. Lossy semantic/model-based compression remains out of scope until an explicit falsifier demonstrates preserved evidence behavior.
Protected evidence/counterevidence/authority rows must survive verbatim or the transformation returns the original payload.

next_exact_gate.owner: Triggerword 6 Experimental Falsifier or Triggerword 4 only after a separately admitted build handoff
next_exact_gate.experiment: On a fixed fixture corpus of exact F2 payloads, compare baseline rendered payloads with an F2-native lossless structural compactor applied only after ContextView selection. Require byte-reconstructability or exact structural equivalence, identical ContextView identity/selected+omitted references, zero evidence/provenance drift, explicit failure on missing/digest-mismatched original, and measured token savings large enough to justify the new layer.
next_exact_gate.promotion_rule: No E5 build candidate unless the ablation shows incremental savings over existing F2 rendering with every deterministic/evidence fence preserved.
